newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM polymer earnings more than triple.
newsitem.headline: DSM polymer earnings more than triple.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Wednesday higher sales volumes across the board and higher profit margins on some products drove a sharp rise in earnings from its polymers and hydrocarbons division.
The division's sales rose to 2.82 billion guilders in the first half of 1997 from 2.06 billion in the same period of 1996 while operating profits jumped to 264 million from 72 million.
DSM said the rise in sales was caused by higher sales volumes for all products and higher price levels compared with the first half of 1996.
Higher sales volumes for hydrocarbons, polyethylene and polypropylene were the main reason for the higher operating profit in the first half of this year.
"Although higher margins were achieved on hydrocarbons and polyethylene, margins on polypropylene, elastomers and engineering plastics were lower due to increased raw-material costs," DSM said.
